# Flossie Tulk

## Overview

- **Age:** Roughly 16 in volume 1  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c11 P25](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0025), [v1 c15 P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c15 P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020)</sub>

## Appearance

Flossie is a heavy-set young woman. She is known to wear flounces on her dresses.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c31 P8](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0008)_

## Personality

Flossie is spiteful, arrogant, and dishonest, frequently mocking others and making malicious remarks. She is competitive, lacks imagination, and boasts about her achievements or background while disparaging those she considers beneath her.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026), [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c24 P17](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0017), [v1 c25 P45](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0045)_

- Walking along wooden fences  <sub>[v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006)</sub>

## Goals

- To surpass Nell Harcourt and excel in school  <sub>[v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c25 P47](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0047)</sub>

## History

Flossie attended Brierley school alongside Nell Harcourt and Isolde Pembroke. She was known to cheat on her spelling tests and mock Nell regarding her temper and red hair. During a Sunday school picnic, she challenged Nell to walk the ridgepole of a roof, leading to Nell's fall and injured ankle. She later attended Regent's Academy with Nell and Hugh Carrow, where she continued her academic rivalry. After failing to win her desired role in the school concert dialogue, she won a prize for her knitted lace at the Exhibition. She eventually passed her Entrance examinations by a narrow margin.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c15 P49](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0049), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011), [v1 c23 P15](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0015), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c25 P45](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0045), [v1 c25 P47](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0047), [v1 c32 P33](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0033)_
